set.body:
Outcome: DL3 detail binding with graded fidelity. Each DL1 atom bound to supporting source rows or none; participant mentions bound to DL2 cast ids or unresolved. Grades: supported, gist-correct with detail error (with severity), contradicted, recaller inference, not in source, unverifiable. Port tools/sherlock_mapper/verify_claims.py into the common pipeline as a new reply protocol; scene assignment unchanged.
Exit: on fresh items coded blind, precision and recall per grade, contradicted and gist-detail reported separately. Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md#dl3-detail-binding-with-graded-fidelity.
set.title: [detail-mapping] DL3 detail binding with graded fidelity
